Contract ManageSupplierCRUDService::createSupplier(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		sup: Supplier = Supplier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		if sup.oclIsUndefined() 
		then let newSup: Supplier in
		newSup.oclIsNew() and
		newSup.Id = id and
		newSup.Name = name and
		Supplier.allInstance()->includes(newSup) and
		result = true 
		else result = false 
		endif 
}
